unrelated.note: Average winning-look similarity for an unrelated everyday outfit.

partial.note: Partial match — some red/two-tone cues but not a recreation.

notes: Game-design calibration anchors (spec §4), NOT a statistical accuracy claim. A raw similarity of 0.76 does not mean 76% costume accuracy. These are PLACEHOLDER values; re-measure lowAnchor (unrelated) and highAnchor (strong recreation) on the actual demo setup with the same reference pipeline before freezing. Requirement: highAnchor > lowAnchor. Recalibrate whenever the encoder, preprocessing, or reference groups change.
